summary: Build practical recovery plans, prioritization matrices, and reporting tools in this 5-day course. Enrol in reconstruction planning training.
lede: Reconstruction planning and disaster recovery help recovery professionals assess damage and organize the restoration of critical services. Designed for people who plan, coordinate or report on recovery work, the course covers damage and needs assessment, prioritizing restoration against dependencies and resource limits, and building phased recovery plans. Exercises also develop stakeholder coordination, progress dashboards and decision-ready reporting from field and operational updates.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who plan, coordinate, or report on recovery work after disruptive events. It is most relevant where you must balance field damage, service restoration, and limited resources inside real operational constraints.
prerequisites: Participants should have a working understanding of emergency management, continuity planning, infrastructure operations, or crisis coordination. Familiarity with damage assessment reporting, basic project planning, and stakeholder briefings is helpful. No coding is required. Advanced concepts such as recovery sequencing analytics and AI-assisted situation summaries are taught at an operational level, with practical application focused on templates, decision rules, and reporting workflows.
